test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The Collector paid floral tributes to the statue of Mahatma Gandhi after hossting the flag.
solution:
The erroneous word is: **hossting**.**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **I**n the given sentence:

 
 
• The word **"hossting"** is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is:** 'hoisting'.**
 
 
 
• It means to raise or lift something, in this case referring to the act of raising the flag.**
 
 
• Example: Hoist your sail when the wind is fair.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "floral" refers to flowers or plants.
 
• Option 2: "statue" is a three-dimensional representation of a person or object.
 
• Option 3: "tributes" are acts or statements of respect or admiration.
